ConnectionStrings.//DefaultConnection: Set locally with: dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection" "<supabase pooler connection string>". In production supply ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection as an environment variable. Never commit the real value here.

Supabase.//: Public issuer. Tokens are ES256-signed; the public keys are fetched from {Issuer}/.well-known/jwks.json, so no secret is needed here.
